verdict.rationale: monday.com's marketing says routine work such as status updates and performance reports can be automated "on a set schedule" (monday-docs-21). Its developer docs describe event-driven workflows: subscribing to events like create_item and change_column_value, running a workflow the moment data changes, and firing when an agent is messaged, assigned or mentioned (monday-docs-7, monday-docs-27, monday-docs-15, monday-docs-31). Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring schedules or recurrence (cron-style intervals, time zones, recurring triggers), clear evidence that engineers can build scheduled workflows themselves rather than only agent-run reports, and independent hands-on corroboration.
